status.software: replay IDENTICAL on the whole playthrough (321,820 frames); unit cases incl. four CPU speeds; 8 negatives detected

techniques.target: scan --writers on the composite cells: only the renderer, the drawers and the background copy read them
the five 13-byte figure records at 42030 (position, colour, frame, mirror bit)
every pixel write kept; one 16 x 16 sprite per figure over its OR-drawn pixels, the attribute paint off
Sinclair 48K ROM as alt ROM image 1, hooks at 0x386E (the game pages ROM 1 only)
28 MHz inside each hook, the caller's NR 7 kept on the stack and put back

results.scope: 1 rzxarchive recording, a whole playthrough (321,820 frames); unit cases (figures, room draw, clear screen) at four CPU speeds; 8 negatives; no human-timed hardware pace

pacing.coverage: Hook T counted in the simulator over the whole playthrough; no JNext or hardware timing.
pacing.result: Figure hook about 27,300 T at 28 MHz per update, about 2.4% of a two-frame update at most.

dependencies.coverage: Every reader of the composite cells (scan --writers) over the recording; the figure loop, the renderer, room draw and clear screen.
dependencies.result: The figures are OR-drawn into composite cells the renderer copies; nothing reads figure pixels back for logic, so the overlay keeps every write and turns the attribute paint off.

feasibility.decision: Figures as sprites in the game's own colours over the kept composite drawing, the attribute paint off (the standing default).
feasibility.next_experiment: A board run of the 1.1 build with turbo chosen: speed kept in play, no stray sprites.
